notes: Language-stack extension to rules-table.json. Same schema (id/scope/exclude/pattern/severity/message/fix). Loaded MERGED with rules-table.json by _engine.py — one union, no drift. Date: 2026-10-30. Status: PROPOSED.

rules.message: exec()/eval() in Python is a code-injection surface.
rules.fix: Replace with ast.literal_eval, a dispatch dict, or a real parser.

rules.message: f-string SQL passed to execute() is an injection hole.
Bare except: swallows KeyboardInterrupt and hides the real error.
rules.fix: Catch Exception (or narrower) and log before handling.

rules.message: print() left in code outside hooks/ (hook scripts print JSON to stdout by contract).
rules.fix: Remove or route through the logging middleware.

rules.message: Explicit any defeats the type gate.
rules.fix: Use unknown and narrow, or a precise type; a cast needs a why-safe comment.
await the chain or return it; enable @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises.

rules.message: unwrap() in non-test Rust panics on the unhappy path.
rules.fix: Return Result with ? or map the error; expect("why") only for proven invariants.

rules.message: expect() needs a proven invariant behind it.
rules.fix: State the invariant in the message or restructure to Result.

rules.message: panic! for an expected failure crashes the process.
rules.fix: Return Result; reserve panic! for unrecoverable bugs.

rules.message: Unquoted variable expansion splits on spaces and globs.
rules.fix: Quote: echo "$VAR". Prefer shellcheck -S error in CI.
Reference the secret manager or env var; keep placeholders only.

rules.message: malloc without a visible NULL check.
rules.fix: Check for NULL immediately, or use a wrapper that aborts cleanly.

rules.message: Raw new/new[] needs a matching delete; prefer ownership types.
fmt.Print* in non-test Go is stdout noise, not logging.
rules.fix: Remove or route through the structured logger.

rules.message: System.out/err printing is not a logging path.
rules.fix: Remove or route through the logging framework.
